mentions.note: two miles walk first class standard medal
died aged under 21; walker known as "Jim"; won Belgrave Open Seven Miles handicap and London Fire Brigade S.C. 2 miles; 5th in Polytechnic Harriers Invitation Team Walk, White City

share.d: H. S. Latter in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1933–1934: 2 mentions in 2 issues and 1 race result.
